Amadeo Alentorn - Head of Systematic Equities at Jupiter ...
Description: Amadeo Alentorn is Head of Systematic Equities at Jupiter Asset Management. Prior to joining Jupiter, as part of the Merian acquisition, he was Head of Research and Fund Manager in the Global Equity Team at Merian Global Investors. He first joined the team in 2005, part of Old Mutual at the time. He manages a range of hedge funds, absolute return and global equity funds, and is responsible for directing the systematic equities research programme. He has extensive experience in [...] ## Experience
- Head of Systematic Equities, Investment Manager at Jupiter Asset Management (Jan 2022 to present)
- Head of Research & Fund Manager - Systematic Equities at Jupiter Asset Management (Jul 2020 to Jan 2022)
- Head of Research & Fund Manager  - Global Equity Team at Merian Global Investors (Oct 2018 to Jul 2020)
- Head of R
